news.title: Monero suffers biggest single-day slide in over 5 months. Here’s why
news.summary: Monero (XMR) crashed over 11% on Thursday, its biggest drop since early June. Back-to-back exchange delistings seem to have catalyzed the price slide.

news.title: Ripple's lending plan moves closer to tapping XRP Ledger's $800 million in stablecoins
news.summary: The vaults that would hold lenders' money are on track to switch on Dec. 9. The loan system that draws from them still needs one more validator to start its own two-week clock.

news.title: Binance says customer withdrawals are fully restored, four weeks after the $6.3 billion hack
news.summary: Binance says it has fully lifted withdrawal suspensions imposed after October’s $6.3 billion hack, though a small number of networks remain paused for unrelated maintenance.
